verdict.rationale: Cal.com's app store lists both HubSpot and Salesforce. Its Zapier app explicitly automates workflows when a booking is created, rescheduled, cancelled or a meeting ends, and the Attio integration syncs bookings into the CRM. Registrable webhooks with BOOKING_CREATED/RESCHEDULED/CANCELLED triggers and routing traces that reference CRM lookups add to this, so bookings can flow onward without manual copying. Missing for 10: documentation of what the Salesforce and HubSpot integrations actually sync (the listings only describe the CRMs themselves), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CRM sync working.
